# 部活動勤怠管理システム 要件定義書（完全版）

## 1. 概要

### 1.1 目的
- Firebaseの読み取り上限問題を解決し、安定した部活動勤怠管理を実現する
- オンプレサーバー不要で無料運用可能なクラウドベースシステムを構築する
- Discord認証と期生ロールを活用した安全なアクセス制御を提供する
- QRコードによる簡単なカード登録機能を実現する

### 1.2 適用範囲
- 対象者：100名以下の部活動メンバー
- 利用端末：ラズベリーパイ1台（打刻・登録用）+ PC・スマートフォン（閲覧・登録完了用）
- 運用環境：学校施設内ネットワーク + インターネット接続

## 2. 機能要件

### 2.1 打刻機能

#### 2.1.1 基本打刻処理
- **機能概要**：NFC/RFIDカードのタッチによる出退勤記録
- **入力**：カードIDのHIDキーボード入力
- **処理**：
  1. カードIDを受信（連続入力+Enter または 0.5秒タイムアウト）
  2. カードIDでユーザー検索
  3. 前回勤務ステータスの逆を適用（初回は全員退勤状態のため出勤扱い）
  4. タイムスタンプ付きでデータベースに記録
- **出力**：WebUI画面での打刻完了表示（5秒間表示後自動復帰）

#### 2.1.2 エラーハンドリング
- **未登録カード**：「未登録のカードです」メッセージを表示
- **通信エラー**：「通信エラーが発生しました」メッセージを表示
- **重複打刻**：短時間連続タッチでも通常処理を実行

#### 2.1.3 自動退勤機能
- **実行方法**：シンプルなGETリクエスト（curl対応）
- **実行URL**：`GET /api/admin/force-logout-all`
- **処理内容**：全員を強制退勤状態に変更
- **ログ出力**：実行履歴をデータベースに保存

### 2.2 カード登録機能

#### 2.2.1 登録開始処理
- **開始方法**：Kiosk画面で「/」キー押下
- **カード読取**：登録したいカードをタッチ
- **仮登録作成**：temp_registrationsテーブルに30分有効期限で保存
- **QRコード表示**：登録用URLを含むQRコードをKiosk画面に表示

#### 2.2.2 QRコード処理
- **QRコード内容**：`https://your-app.vercel.app/register/{qr_token}`
- **アクセス検知**：QRコードが読み取られると自動的にKiosk画面が通常状態に復帰
- **有効期限**：30分（期限切れ後は自動削除）

#### 2.2.3 本登録処理
- **実行端末**：スマートフォン
- **認証フロー**：Discord OAuth認証 → 期生ロール確認
- **登録完了**：usersテーブルへの本登録とtemp_registrationsの無効化
- **完了通知**：登録完了画面をスマートフォンに表示

### 2.3 認証機能

#### 2.3.1 Discord OAuth認証
- **認証方式**：Discord OAuth + Supabase Auth連携
- **アクセス制限**：特定Discordサーバーメンバーのみ
- **ロール確認**：期生ロールの付与確認
- **エラー処理**：非メンバーのアクセス時はエラー画面表示

#### 2.3.2 権限管理
- **一般ユーザー**：自分の勤怠データ閲覧のみ
- **管理者**：全ユーザーデータ閲覧 + ユーザー管理機能 + カード管理機能
- **権限設定**：管理者がユーザー管理画面から設定

### 2.4 勤怠閲覧機能

#### 2.4.1 個人勤怠表示
- **表示内容**：個人の出退勤履歴（カレンダー形式）
- **統計情報**：出勤率、出勤日数、総労働時間
- **操作方式**：キーボード操作を基本とし、マウス使用を最小限に抑制

#### 2.4.2 管理者用集計表示
- **表示内容**：日別の班・学年別人数集計
- **操作方法**：カレンダー日付クリックで該当日データを表示
- **班別フィルタ**：サイドバーでの班選択による絞り込み表示

### 2.5 ユーザー管理機能

#### 2.5.1 ユーザー情報管理（修正）
- **管理項目**：
  - DiscordユーザーID（数字のみ）
  - 表示用ニックネーム（display_name）
  - カードID（1枚のみ、NOT NULL制約）
  - 期生
  - 班（teamsテーブルへの外部キー）
  - 権限レベル（0:部員, 1:管理者）
- **操作機能**：強制出退勤、ユーザー情報編集、カードID変更（管理者のみ）
- **変更履歴**：全ての編集操作を履歴として保存

#### 2.5.2 データ移行機能
- **移行元**：Firebase
- **移行内容**：既存ユーザー情報、勤怠履歴
- **移行先**：Supabase PostgreSQL
- **変換処理**：Discord名の数字形式への変換

### 2.6 お知らせ機能

#### 2.6.1 お知らせ表示
- **表示場所**：Kiosk画面上部
- **表示件数**：1件のみ（is_current=trueフラグで管理）
- **更新方式**：Supabase Realtimeによる自動更新

#### 2.6.2 お知らせ管理
- **作成・編集**：管理者のみ
- **履歴管理**：論理削除による過去データ保持
- **表示切替**：任意のお知らせを現在表示に設定可能

## 3. 非機能要件

### 3.1 性能要件
- **応答時間**：打刻処理3秒以内、画面表示2秒以内
- **同時利用者数**：制限なし（Vercel・Supabase無料プラン範囲内）
- **データ集計**：マテリアライズドビューによる高速集計処理

### 3.2 可用性要件
- **稼働時間**：24時間365日（ラズベリーパイ常時稼働）
- **利用時間**：部活動時間帯（実際の打刻は活動時のみ）
- **一時停止対策**：定期的なSupabaseヘルスチェック実行

### 3.3 セキュリティ要件
- **個人情報保護**：Supabaseには個人情報を保存せず、DiscordユーザーIDのみ保存
- **アクセス制御**：Discord OAuth + 期生ロール確認
- **データ暗号化**：HTTPS通信、Supabase標準暗号化
- **QRセキュリティ**：トークンの暗号化と有効期限管理

### 3.4 運用性要件
- **データ保持**：勤怠データは永続保存
- **ログ管理**：
  - 全員退勤API実行ログ
  - ユーザー情報変更履歴
  - QRコード登録アクセスログ
- **バックアップ**：Supabase自動バックアップ機能を利用
- **データクリーンアップ**：期限切れ仮登録データの自動削除

## 4. 制約条件

### 4.1 技術制約
- **使用技術**：Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, Discord OAuth
- **無料プラン制限**：
  - Supabase：500MB DB容量、50,000 MAU
  - Vercel：100GB転送量、非商用利用
- **カード制限**：1ユーザーあたり1枚のみ

### 4.2 運用制約
- **予算制約**：月額費用0円での運用
- **ネットワーク制約**：オンプレサーバー設置不可
- **登録制約**：QRコード有効期限30分

### 4.3 ハードウェア制約
- **打刻端末**：ラズベリーパイ1台のみ
- **カードリーダー**：HIDキーボード入力対応NFC/RFIDリーダー
- **登録端末**：スマートフォン（QRコード読取・Discord認証用）

## 5. インターフェース要件

### 5.1 外部システム連携
- **Discord API**：OAuth認証、ユーザー情報取得、ロール確認
- **Supabase API**：データベース操作、リアルタイム更新
- **QRコード生成**：qrcode.jsライブラリによる動的生成

### 5.2 ユーザーインターフェース

#### 5.2.1 Kiosk画面（ラズベリーパイ）
- **通常画面**：時刻表示、お知らせ表示、打刻指示
- **入力中画面**：カードID入力状況のリアルタイム表示
- **結果画面**：打刻成功・エラーの5秒間表示
- **登録画面**：QRコード表示とアクセス検知による自動復帰

#### 5.2.2 管理画面
- **個人ダッシュボード**：レスポンシブWebアプリ（PC・スマートフォン対応）
- **管理者ダッシュボード**：ユーザー管理、お知らせ管理、集計表示
- **登録画面**：スマートフォン専用レスポンシブデザイン

#### 5.2.3 操作方式
- **Kiosk画面**：キーボード操作優先設計（/キー：登録開始、Escキー：キャンセル）
- **Web画面**：タッチ・マウス・キーボード操作対応

## 6. 画面遷移要件

### 6.1 Kiosk画面遷移
- **通常待機** → **入力中** → **結果表示** → **通常待機**
- **通常待機** → **登録モード** → **QRコード表示** → **通常待機**（QR読取検知時）

### 6.2 スマートフォン画面遷移
- **QRコード読取** → **登録確認** → **Discord認証** → **登録完了**

### 6.3 自動復帰機能
- **結果表示画面**：5秒後に自動復帰
- **QRコード画面**：読取検知時に即座に復帰
- **エラー画面**：5秒後に自動復帰

---
title: "basic_punch (kintai-v3: Attendance Punch Processing)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_receive: receive card_id via HID keyboard input
    q_receive --> q_timeout_check: input buffer accumulating
    q_timeout_check --> q_receive: no Enter and elapsed < 0.5s
    q_timeout_check --> q_lookup: Enter received OR 0.5s timeout
    q_lookup --> q_check_user: query users by card_id
    q_check_user --> q_error_unregistered: user not found
    q_check_user --> q_get_status: user found
    q_error_unregistered --> [*]: display "unregistered card" for 5s
    q_get_status --> q_toggle: fetch last attendance status
    q_toggle --> q_clock_in: previous status = "out" OR first punch
    q_toggle --> q_clock_out: previous status = "in"
    q_clock_in --> q_save: action = "clock_in"
    q_clock_out --> q_save: action = "clock_out"
    q_save --> q_display: insert attendance record with timestamp
    q_save --> q_error_comm: communication error
    q_error_comm --> [*]: display "communication error" for 5s
    q_display --> [*]: display punch result for 5s then auto-return

    note right of q_toggle
        INV-001: status toggles between "in" and "out" on each punch
        INV-002: first punch for any user is always clock_in (initial status = out)
        INV-003: every attendance record has a non-null timestamp
    end note

    note right of q_receive
        INV-004: card_id is received as HID keyboard input (consecutive chars + Enter or 0.5s timeout)
        INV-005: duplicate rapid punches are processed normally (no debounce)
    end note

---
title: "force_logout_all (kintai-v3: Auto Force Logout All Users)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_receive: GET /api/admin/force-logout-all
    q_receive --> q_update: update all users status = "out"
    q_update --> q_log: write execution log to database
    q_log --> [*]: return success response

    note right of q_update
        INV-001: after execution, all users have status = "out"
        INV-002: execution is logged with timestamp in database
        INV-003: endpoint is a simple GET (curl-compatible)
    end note

---
title: "card_registration_kiosk (kintai-v3: Card Registration Start on Kiosk)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_wait: kiosk normal standby mode
    q_wait --> q_reg_mode: "/" key pressed
    q_reg_mode --> q_read_card: enter registration mode
    q_read_card --> q_cancel: Esc key pressed
    q_cancel --> [*]: return to normal standby
    q_read_card --> q_create_temp: card touched, card_id captured
    q_create_temp --> q_gen_qr: insert temp_registrations(card_id, qr_token, expires_at = now + 30min)
    q_gen_qr --> q_show_qr: generate QR code with URL "https://app/register/{qr_token}"
    q_show_qr --> q_poll: display QR code on kiosk screen
    q_poll --> q_detected: QR code scanned (access detected)
    q_poll --> q_expired: 30 minutes elapsed
    q_expired --> q_cleanup: delete expired temp_registration
    q_cleanup --> [*]: return to normal standby
    q_detected --> [*]: return to normal standby immediately

    note right of q_create_temp
        INV-001: temp_registration expires_at = creation_time + 30 minutes
        INV-002: qr_token is cryptographically random and unique
        INV-003: expired temp_registrations are automatically deleted
    end note

    note right of q_show_qr
        INV-004: kiosk returns to normal on QR scan detection or expiry
        INV-005: only one temp_registration per card_id at a time
    end note

---
title: "card_registration_complete (kintai-v3: Full Registration via Smartphone)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_scan_qr: user scans QR code on smartphone
    q_scan_qr --> q_load_temp: GET /register/{qr_token}
    q_load_temp --> q_check_expiry: lookup temp_registrations by qr_token
    q_check_expiry --> q_expired: expires_at < now
    q_expired --> [*]: display "registration expired" error
    q_check_expiry --> q_show_confirm: valid temp_registration found
    q_show_confirm --> q_discord_auth: user confirms registration
    q_discord_auth --> q_oauth_redirect: redirect to Discord OAuth
    q_oauth_redirect --> q_check_server: Discord OAuth callback received
    q_check_server --> q_auth_fail: user not in target Discord server
    q_auth_fail --> [*]: display "not a server member" error
    q_check_server --> q_check_role: user is server member
    q_check_role --> q_role_fail: user lacks required generation role
    q_role_fail --> [*]: display "missing role" error
    q_check_role --> q_register: generation role confirmed
    q_register --> q_insert_user: insert into users(discord_id, display_name, card_id, generation, role=0)
    q_insert_user --> q_invalidate: invalidate temp_registration (mark used)
    q_invalidate --> [*]: display "registration complete" on smartphone

    note right of q_register
        INV-001: card_id from temp_registration is transferred to users table
        INV-002: user.card_id is NOT NULL (exactly 1 card per user)
        INV-003: temp_registration is invalidated after successful registration
        INV-004: discord_id stores numeric ID only (no personal info in Supabase)
    end note

    note right of q_check_server
        INV-005: only members of the specific Discord server can register
        INV-006: generation role must be present on the Discord user
    end note

---
title: "discord_oauth (kintai-v3: Discord OAuth Authentication Flow)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_init: user accesses protected page
    q_init --> q_redirect: redirect to Discord OAuth authorize endpoint
    q_redirect --> q_callback: user authorizes, Discord redirects with code
    q_callback --> q_exchange: exchange code for access token via Supabase Auth
    q_exchange --> q_fetch_user: fetch Discord user info + guilds
    q_fetch_user --> q_check_guild: check if user is member of target guild
    q_check_guild --> q_denied: user not in target guild
    q_denied --> [*]: display access denied error
    q_check_guild --> q_check_role: user is guild member
    q_check_role --> q_denied_role: user lacks generation role
    q_denied_role --> [*]: display missing role error
    q_check_role --> q_session: generation role confirmed
    q_session --> q_resolve_perm: create Supabase auth session
    q_resolve_perm --> q_authorized: lookup user in users table, resolve permission_level
    q_authorized --> [*]: return authenticated session with role

    note right of q_check_guild
        INV-001: only members of the specific Discord server are allowed
        INV-002: authentication uses Discord OAuth + Supabase Auth integration
    end note

    note right of q_resolve_perm
        INV-003: permission_level 0 = regular member, 1 = admin
        INV-004: permission_level is stored in users table, set by admin
    end note

---
title: "authorization_check (kintai-v3: Permission and Access Control)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_check_session: incoming request with session
    q_check_session --> q_no_session: session invalid or missing
    q_no_session --> [*]: redirect to Discord OAuth login
    q_check_session --> q_get_role: valid session, extract user_id
    q_get_role --> q_check_perm: query users.permission_level by user_id
    q_check_perm --> q_member: permission_level = 0
    q_check_perm --> q_admin: permission_level = 1
    q_member --> q_member_gate: request requires admin?
    q_member_gate --> q_forbidden: yes, admin required
    q_forbidden --> [*]: return 403 forbidden
    q_member_gate --> q_self_only: no, member access
    q_self_only --> [*]: allow access to own data only
    q_admin --> [*]: allow access to all data + management functions

    note right of q_check_perm
        INV-001: regular members (level 0) can only view their own attendance data
        INV-002: admins (level 1) can view all data + manage users + manage cards + manage announcements
        INV-003: permission_level is set by admin via user management screen
    end note

---
title: "personal_attendance_view (kintai-v3: Individual Attendance Display)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_auth: user accesses personal dashboard
    q_auth --> q_denied: not authenticated
    q_denied --> [*]: redirect to login
    q_auth --> q_load: authenticated, fetch own attendance records
    q_load --> q_render_cal: query attendance_records WHERE user_id = current_user
    q_render_cal --> q_calc_stats: render calendar view with attendance entries
    q_calc_stats --> q_display: compute attendance_rate, total_days, total_hours
    q_display --> [*]: display calendar + statistics

    note right of q_load
        INV-001: user can only query attendance records where user_id matches their own
        INV-002: statistics (rate, days, hours) are derived from materialized views for performance
    end note

---
title: "admin_aggregate_view (kintai-v3: Admin Attendance Aggregation)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_auth: admin accesses aggregate dashboard
    q_auth --> q_denied: not admin (permission_level != 1)
    q_denied --> [*]: return 403 forbidden
    q_auth --> q_load_cal: admin authenticated
    q_load_cal --> q_select_date: display calendar with all dates
    q_select_date --> q_query: admin clicks specific date
    q_query --> q_aggregate: fetch attendance for selected date
    q_aggregate --> q_filter: compute per-team and per-grade headcounts
    q_filter --> q_display: sidebar team filter applied
    q_display --> q_select_date: display filtered results, await next date selection
    q_display --> [*]: admin leaves page

    note right of q_aggregate
        INV-001: aggregation uses materialized views for fast query
        INV-002: only users with permission_level = 1 can access this view
        INV-003: team filter uses foreign key to teams table
    end note

---
title: "user_management (kintai-v3: Admin User Management)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_auth: admin accesses user management
    q_auth --> q_denied: not admin
    q_denied --> [*]: return 403 forbidden
    q_auth --> q_list: admin authenticated, load user list
    q_list --> q_select: display all users
    q_select --> q_edit: select user to edit
    q_edit --> q_validate: modify fields (display_name, generation, team, permission_level, card_id)
    q_validate --> q_invalid: validation failed (e.g. discord_id not numeric)
    q_invalid --> q_edit: show validation error
    q_validate --> q_save: validation passed
    q_save --> q_log_change: update users table
    q_log_change --> q_list: insert change record into edit history
    q_select --> q_force_action: select force clock-in/out
    q_force_action --> q_save_force: update user attendance status
    q_save_force --> q_list: record forced action with timestamp

    note right of q_validate
        INV-001: discord_id must be numeric only
        INV-002: card_id is NOT NULL, exactly 1 card per user
        INV-003: team references teams table via foreign key
        INV-004: all edit operations are recorded in change history
    end note

    note right of q_force_action
        INV-005: forced clock-in/out is logged separately from normal punches
        INV-006: only admin (permission_level = 1) can perform force actions
    end note

---
title: "announcement_management (kintai-v3: Announcement Display and Management)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_load: kiosk or web loads announcements
    q_load --> q_query: query announcements WHERE is_current = true
    q_query --> q_display: display single current announcement on kiosk header
    q_display --> q_realtime: subscribe to Supabase Realtime changes
    q_realtime --> q_update: realtime event received (announcement changed)
    q_update --> q_display: re-render with updated announcement
    q_realtime --> [*]: connection closed

    note right of q_query
        INV-001: only one announcement has is_current = true at any time
        INV-002: announcements use logical deletion (soft delete)
        INV-003: updates propagate via Supabase Realtime subscription
    end note

---
title: "announcement_admin (kintai-v3: Admin Announcement CRUD)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_auth: admin accesses announcement management
    q_auth --> q_denied: not admin
    q_denied --> [*]: return 403 forbidden
    q_auth --> q_list: admin authenticated, load announcement list
    q_list --> q_create: create new announcement
    q_create --> q_save_new: insert announcement(content, is_current=false)
    q_save_new --> q_list: return to list
    q_list --> q_edit: select existing announcement
    q_edit --> q_save_edit: update announcement content
    q_save_edit --> q_list: return to list
    q_list --> q_set_current: set announcement as current display
    q_set_current --> q_unset_others: set is_current = false for all other announcements
    q_unset_others --> q_set_target: set is_current = true for selected announcement
    q_set_target --> q_list: Supabase Realtime broadcasts change
    q_list --> q_delete: soft-delete announcement
    q_delete --> q_list: set deleted_at timestamp (logical delete)

    note right of q_set_current
        INV-001: exactly one announcement has is_current = true after set operation
        INV-002: setting current atomically unsets all others first
    end note

    note right of q_delete
        INV-003: announcements are never physically deleted (logical delete only)
        INV-004: only admin can create, edit, delete, or set current announcement
    end note

---
title: "kiosk_screen_transitions (kintai-v3: Kiosk UI State Machine)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_standby: kiosk boot, display clock + announcement
    q_standby --> q_input: card touch detected (HID input begins)
    q_input --> q_result: card_id complete (Enter or 0.5s timeout)
    q_result --> q_standby: 5 seconds elapsed, auto-return
    q_standby --> q_reg_mode: "/" key pressed
    q_reg_mode --> q_standby: Esc key pressed
    q_reg_mode --> q_qr_display: card touched, QR code generated
    q_qr_display --> q_standby: QR code scanned (access detected)
    q_qr_display --> q_standby: 30 minutes elapsed (expired)
    q_result --> q_standby: error displayed for 5 seconds, auto-return

    note right of q_standby
        INV-001: standby shows current time and active announcement
        INV-002: all non-standby screens auto-return to standby
    end note

    note right of q_result
        INV-003: result screen displays for exactly 5 seconds
        INV-004: result shows success (clock-in/out) or error (unregistered/comm error)
    end note

    note right of q_qr_display
        INV-005: QR screen returns immediately on scan detection
        INV-006: QR screen returns after 30-minute expiry if not scanned
    end note

---
title: "temp_registration_cleanup (kintai-v3: Expired Temp Registration Cleanup)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_scan: periodic cleanup trigger
    q_scan --> q_query: SELECT * FROM temp_registrations WHERE expires_at < now()
    q_query --> q_none: no expired records found
    q_none --> [*]: no action needed
    q_query --> q_delete: expired records found
    q_delete --> [*]: DELETE expired temp_registrations

    note right of q_query
        INV-001: temp_registrations with expires_at < now() are eligible for deletion
        INV-002: cleanup preserves all non-expired temp_registrations
        INV-003: cleanup runs periodically (not triggered by user action)
    end note

content.content:
# 部活動勤怠管理システム 詳細設計書

## 1. はじめに

### 1.1 設計方針
- データベーススキーマを`members`（部員情報）と`attendance`（勤怠情報）に分割し、関心を分離する。
- 班や役職などの情報は`members`スキーマで管理し、勤怠関連の操作は`attendance`スキーマに限定する。
- Discord OAuth統合による安全な認証を維持する。
- キーボード操作優先のUI設計と既存kiosk画面との整合性を確保する。
- QRコード読み取り後の自動画面遷移による使いやすさを向上させる。

### 1.2 想定読者
- システム開発者
- 部活動管理者
- システム運用担当者

### 1.3 関連ドキュメント
- 部活動勤怠管理システム企画書
- 部活動勤怠管理システム要件定義書

## 2. データベース設計

### 2.1 スキーマ構成
- **members**: 部員の基本情報、班、役職などを管理するスキーマ。
- **attendance**: NFCカードIDと勤怠ログのみを管理するスキーマ。

### 2.2 テーブル構成図

#### `members` スキーマ
```
-- 部員の基本情報
users (ユーザーテーブル)
├── id (PK, uuid, references auth.users(id)) -- Supabase認証ID
├── display_name (unique, varchar) -- 表示用ID兼ニックネーム
├── discord_id (varchar, unique) -- Discord連携用（数字のみ）
├── generation (int) -- 期生
├── status (int) -- 0:中学生, 1:高校生, 2:OB/OG
├── student_number (varchar, nullable) -- 学籍番号
├── is_admin (boolean, default: false) -- 管理者権限
├── created_at, updated_at
└── deleted_at (timestamptz, nullable) -- 論理削除用

-- 班の情報
teams (班テーブル)
├── id (PK, int, generated by default as identity)
├── name (varchar, 班名)
├── discord_role_id (varchar, nullable) -- 対応DiscordロールID
└── created_at

-- メンバーと班の多対多関係
member_team_relations (所属関係テーブル)
├── member_id (PK, FK → members.users.id)
├── team_id (PK, FK → members.teams.id)
└── created_at

-- 各班の班長
team_leaders (班長テーブル)
├── team_id (PK, FK → members.teams.id)
├── member_id (PK, FK → members.users.id)

-- 期とDiscordロールの紐付け
generation_roles (期生ロールテーブル)
├── generation (PK, int)
└── discord_role_id (varchar, unique)
```

#### `attendance` スキーマ
```
-- カードIDとユーザーIDの紐付け
users (勤怠ユーザーテーブル)
├── id (PK, uuid, references members.users.id)
├── card_id (varchar, not null, unique) -- カードID
└── created_at, updated_at

-- 出退勤記録
attendances (出退勤記録)
├── id (PK, uuid)
├── user_id (FK → attendance.users.id)
├── type (varchar) -- 'in' or 'out'
├── timestamp (timestamptz) -- 打刻時刻
├── date (date) -- 日付（集計用インデックス）
└── created_at

-- 仮登録情報
temp_registrations (仮登録テーブル)
├── id (PK, uuid)
├── card_id (varchar, unique) -- カードID
├── qr_token (varchar, unique) -- QRコード用トークン
├── expires_at (timestamptz) -- 有効期限（30分）
├── is_used (boolean) -- 使用済みフラグ
├── accessed_at (timestamptz, nullable) -- QR読み取り時刻
└── created_at

-- ログ関連テーブル（変更なし）
user_edit_logs
daily_logout_logs
announcements
```

### 2.3 パフォーマンス設計
```sql
-- `members` スキーマ
CREATE INDEX idx_members_users_generation ON members.users (generation);
CREATE INDEX idx_members_users_discord_id ON members.users (discord_id);

-- `attendance` スキーマ
CREATE INDEX idx_attendances_date_user ON attendance.attendances (date, user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_attendances_user_timestamp ON attendance.attendances (user_id, timestamp);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_attendance_users_card_id ON attendance.users (card_id);
```

## 3. API設計 (サーバーアクション)

### 3.1 認証・登録フロー

#### 新規登録フロー
1. **Kiosk側**：「/」キー押下 → 登録したいカードをタッチ
2. **Backend**: `createTempRegistration` 実行
    - `attendance.users` にカードIDが未登録か確認
    - `attendance.temp_registrations` に仮登録情報を作成
    - QRコード用トークンを返却
3. **Kiosk側**：QRコード生成・表示
4. **スマートフォン側**：QRコード読取 → `accessed_at` 更新 → Kiosk画面自動復帰
5. **スマートフォン側**：Discord OAuth認証
6. **スマートフォン側**：情報入力フォーム表示
7. **Backend**: `completeRegistration` 実行
    - `members.users` にユーザー情報を登録
    - `attendance.users` に `{id: ユーザーID, card_id: カードID}` を登録
    - `members.member_team_relations` に所属班情報を登録
    - `attendance.temp_registrations` を使用済みに更新

## 4. 画面設計

### 4.1 登録画面 (`/register/:token`)
- **入力項目**: 表示名、**学籍番号**、**身分(中学/高校/OG)**、期生、班
- 認証後にこれらの情報を入力するフォームを表示する。

### 4.2 管理者ダッシュボード (`/admin`)
- **ユーザー管理**: `members.users` テーブルと `attendance.users` テーブルを結合して情報を表示。カードIDの変更や、ユーザー情報の編集（所属班、管理者権限など）が可能。

## 5. 運用・監視設計

### 5.1 定期処理
- 変更なし

### 5.2 ログ・監視項目
- 変更なし

### 5.3 バックアップ・復旧
- 変更なし

### 5.4 セキュリティ対策
- **スキーマ分離**: `attendance`スキーマは勤怠専用とし、個人情報（`members`スキーマ）への直接アクセスを限定。RLS（Row Level Security）ポリシーを各スキーマに適切に設定する。
- その他変更なし。

---
title: "createTempRegistration (kintai-v3: Detailed Design)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_receive: receive card_id from kiosk
    q_receive --> q_check_existing: query attendance.users WHERE card_id = input
    q_check_existing --> q_error_already_registered: card_id exists in attendance.users
    q_check_existing --> q_check_temp: card_id not in attendance.users
    q_check_temp --> q_error_pending: active temp_registration exists for card_id AND NOT expired
    q_check_temp --> q_create_temp: no active temp_registration
    q_create_temp --> q_gen_token: generate qr_token (unique)
    q_gen_token --> q_insert: INSERT INTO attendance.temp_registrations(card_id, qr_token, expires_at, is_used)
    q_insert --> q_return: return qr_token
    q_return --> [*]: return token to kiosk for QR generation
    q_error_already_registered --> [*]: revert - card already registered
    q_error_pending --> [*]: revert - pending registration exists

    note right of q_check_existing
        INV-001: card_id in attendance.users has UNIQUE constraint
        INV-002: Each card_id maps to at most one user
    end note

    note right of q_gen_token
        INV-003: qr_token must be unique across temp_registrations
        INV-004: expires_at = now() + 30 minutes
        INV-005: is_used initialized to false
    end note

---
title: "completeRegistration (kintai-v3: Detailed Design)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_receive: receive token, user_info, auth_session
    q_receive --> q_validate_auth: validate Discord OAuth session
    q_validate_auth --> q_error_auth: auth invalid
    q_validate_auth --> q_lookup_temp: auth valid - query temp_registrations WHERE qr_token = token
    q_lookup_temp --> q_error_token: token not found
    q_lookup_temp --> q_check_expiry: token found
    q_check_expiry --> q_error_expired: expires_at < now() OR is_used = true
    q_check_expiry --> q_validate_input: token valid and not expired
    q_validate_input --> q_error_input: display_name empty OR generation invalid OR status invalid
    q_validate_input --> q_insert_member: input valid
    q_insert_member --> q_insert_attendance: INSERT INTO members.users(id, display_name, discord_id, generation, status, student_number)
    q_insert_attendance --> q_insert_teams: INSERT INTO attendance.users(id, card_id)
    q_insert_teams --> q_mark_used: INSERT INTO members.member_team_relations(member_id, team_id) for each team
    q_mark_used --> q_return: UPDATE temp_registrations SET is_used = true WHERE qr_token = token
    q_return --> [*]: return success
    q_error_auth --> [*]: revert - authentication failed
    q_error_token --> [*]: revert - invalid token
    q_error_expired --> [*]: revert - token expired or already used
    q_error_input --> [*]: revert - invalid input data

    note right of q_insert_member
        INV-001: members.users.id references auth.users(id) from Discord OAuth
        INV-002: display_name must be unique across members.users
        INV-003: discord_id must be unique across members.users
        INV-004: All inserts (members.users, attendance.users, member_team_relations) must be atomic (transaction)
    end note

    note right of q_check_expiry
        INV-005: temp_registration expires after 30 minutes
        INV-006: is_used = true prevents reuse of token
    end note

---
title: "recordAttendance (kintai-v3: Detailed Design)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_receive: receive card_id from NFC reader
    q_receive --> q_lookup_user: query attendance.users WHERE card_id = input
    q_lookup_user --> q_error_unknown: card_id not found
    q_lookup_user --> q_get_last: card_id found - get user_id
    q_get_last --> q_determine_type: query latest attendance record for user_id on current date
    q_determine_type --> q_set_in: no record today OR last type = 'out'
    q_determine_type --> q_set_out: last type = 'in'
    q_set_in --> q_insert: type = 'in'
    q_set_out --> q_insert: type = 'out'
    q_insert --> q_return: INSERT INTO attendance.attendances(user_id, type, timestamp, date)
    q_return --> [*]: return attendance record with user display info

    q_error_unknown --> [*]: revert - unregistered card

    note right of q_determine_type
        INV-001: type alternates between 'in' and 'out' per user per day
        INV-002: first record of the day is always 'in'
        INV-003: timestamp is server-side now(), not client-provided
    end note

    note right of q_insert
        INV-004: date field derived from timestamp for indexing
        INV-005: user_id references attendance.users(id)
    end note

---
title: "qrTokenAccess (kintai-v3: Detailed Design)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_receive: smartphone scans QR code with token
    q_receive --> q_lookup: query temp_registrations WHERE qr_token = token
    q_lookup --> q_error_not_found: token not found
    q_lookup --> q_check_valid: token found
    q_check_valid --> q_error_expired: expires_at < now()
    q_check_valid --> q_check_used: not expired
    q_check_used --> q_error_used: is_used = true
    q_check_used --> q_update_accessed: is_used = false
    q_update_accessed --> q_notify_kiosk: UPDATE temp_registrations SET accessed_at = now()
    q_notify_kiosk --> q_redirect: notify kiosk to return to main screen
    q_redirect --> [*]: redirect smartphone to Discord OAuth login

    q_error_not_found --> [*]: show error - invalid QR code
    q_error_expired --> [*]: show error - QR code expired
    q_error_used --> [*]: show error - QR code already used

    note right of q_update_accessed
        INV-001: accessed_at records when QR was scanned (audit trail)
        INV-002: Kiosk screen auto-returns after QR scan detected
    end note

    note right of q_check_valid
        INV-003: Token validity window is 30 minutes from creation
        INV-004: is_used flag prevents replay of completed registrations
    end note

---
title: "adminUserManagement (kintai-v3: Detailed Design)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_auth: admin accesses /admin dashboard
    q_auth --> q_error_unauth: user is_admin = false
    q_auth --> q_load_users: user is_admin = true
    q_load_users --> q_display: JOIN members.users WITH attendance.users ON id
    q_display --> q_select_action: admin selects user and action
    q_select_action --> q_edit_info: edit user info
    q_select_action --> q_edit_card: change card_id
    q_select_action --> q_edit_teams: edit team assignments
    q_select_action --> q_toggle_admin: toggle admin flag
    q_select_action --> q_soft_delete: soft delete user

    q_edit_info --> q_validate: validate input (display_name, generation, status, student_number)
    q_validate --> q_error_input: validation failed
    q_validate --> q_update_member: UPDATE members.users SET fields
    q_update_member --> q_log: INSERT INTO attendance.user_edit_logs
    q_log --> [*]: return success

    q_edit_card --> q_check_card_unique: check new card_id uniqueness
    q_check_card_unique --> q_error_card_dup: card_id already in use
    q_check_card_unique --> q_update_card: UPDATE attendance.users SET card_id = new_card_id
    q_update_card --> q_log

    q_edit_teams --> q_update_teams: DELETE + INSERT member_team_relations
    q_update_teams --> q_log

    q_toggle_admin --> q_update_admin: UPDATE members.users SET is_admin = NOT is_admin
    q_update_admin --> q_log

    q_soft_delete --> q_mark_deleted: UPDATE members.users SET deleted_at = now()
    q_mark_deleted --> q_log

    q_error_unauth --> [*]: revert - not authorized
    q_error_input --> [*]: revert - invalid input
    q_error_card_dup --> [*]: revert - card_id already in use

    note right of q_auth
        INV-001: Only users with is_admin = true can access admin dashboard
        INV-002: RLS policies enforce admin-only access at database level
    end note

    note right of q_update_member
        INV-003: display_name uniqueness must be enforced
        INV-004: All edits are logged in user_edit_logs for audit trail
    end note

    note right of q_soft_delete
        INV-005: Soft delete sets deleted_at, does not remove row
        INV-006: Soft-deleted users should be excluded from active queries
    end note

---
title: "kioskCardScan (kintai-v3: Detailed Design)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_idle: kiosk waiting for input
    q_idle --> q_register_mode: '/' key pressed
    q_idle --> q_attendance_mode: NFC card touched (default mode)

    q_register_mode --> q_wait_card: display "Touch card to register"
    q_wait_card --> q_call_temp_reg: NFC card touched - read card_id
    q_call_temp_reg --> q_show_qr: createTempRegistration returns qr_token
    q_call_temp_reg --> q_show_error: createTempRegistration returns error
    q_show_qr --> q_wait_scan: display QR code with token URL
    q_wait_scan --> q_idle: QR scanned (accessed_at updated) OR timeout
    q_show_error --> q_idle: display error then return to idle

    q_attendance_mode --> q_call_record: read card_id from NFC
    q_call_record --> q_show_result: recordAttendance returns record
    q_call_record --> q_show_error_att: recordAttendance returns error
    q_show_result --> q_idle: display check-in/out confirmation
    q_show_error_att --> q_idle: display error message

    note right of q_idle
        INV-001: Default mode is attendance (NFC touch triggers check-in/out)
        INV-002: '/' key switches to registration mode
        INV-003: Keyboard-first UI design for kiosk operation
    end note

    note right of q_wait_scan
        INV-004: QR display auto-dismisses on scan detection or 30-min timeout
        INV-005: Kiosk returns to idle after QR is scanned (auto screen transition)
    end note

---
title: "rlsPolicyEnforcement (kintai-v3: Detailed Design)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_request: database query received
    q_request --> q_check_schema: determine target schema
    q_check_schema --> q_members_rls: target = members schema
    q_check_schema --> q_attendance_rls: target = attendance schema

    q_members_rls --> q_check_admin: check requesting user is_admin
    q_check_admin --> q_allow_full: is_admin = true
    q_check_admin --> q_check_self: is_admin = false
    q_check_self --> q_allow_read_own: query targets own user record
    q_check_self --> q_deny: query targets other user records
    q_allow_full --> [*]: allow query
    q_allow_read_own --> [*]: allow read-only on own record

    q_attendance_rls --> q_check_att_role: check role and operation
    q_check_att_role --> q_allow_kiosk: service_role (kiosk backend)
    q_check_att_role --> q_check_att_self: authenticated user
    q_allow_kiosk --> [*]: allow insert/read for attendance operations
    q_check_att_self --> q_allow_read_att: read own attendance records
    q_check_att_self --> q_deny_write: write attempt by non-service role
    q_allow_read_att --> [*]: allow read
    q_deny_write --> [*]: deny - only service_role can write attendance
    q_deny --> [*]: deny - insufficient permissions

    note right of q_members_rls
        INV-001: members schema separates personal info from attendance data
        INV-002: Non-admin users can only read their own member record
        INV-003: Admin users have full CRUD on members schema
    end note

    note right of q_attendance_rls
        INV-004: Attendance writes restricted to service_role (backend only)
        INV-005: Users can read their own attendance records
        INV-006: Schema separation limits blast radius of compromised credentials
    end note
